definitions.explanation: Honorific form of {言|い}う, used to show respect toward the speaker being referenced.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}がおっしゃったことを{覚|おぼ}えていますか。
examples.english: Do you remember what the teacher said?

examples.japanese: おっしゃる{通|とお}りです。
{何|なん}とおっしゃいましたか。
examples.notes: Polite way to ask someone to repeat

notes:
おっしゃる is an honorific ({尊敬語|そんけいご}) verb used when referring to what someone of higher status says.

CONJUGATION:
- おっしゃいます (polite)
- おっしゃって (te-form)
- おっしゃった (past)

KEIGO TYPE:
- {尊敬語|そんけいご} (sonkeigo): Honorific language
- Humble equivalent: {申|もう}す, {申|もう}し{上|あ}げる
